body.x: LG Electronics participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced LG ThinQ, which makes home-appliances in house smarter in a word.

LG Electronics directed living spaces which a customer actually lives such as living room, kitchen, and laundry room in the artificial intelligence exhibition zone, taking 1/3 of the whole booth of LG Electronics and displayed not only independent developed artificial intelligence platform ‘Deep ThinQ’, but also products equipped with outside various artificial intelligence technologies.

Voice recognition artificial intelligence Hub ThinQ developed by LG, is linked to all the smart home-appliances in house. Notification of collection of laundry, notification of shelf life from a refrigerator, automatic operation of air conditioner when the user is on his/her way home, a robot cleaner that can clean remotely, and door open detection makes people’s lives more conveniently. Through 20W high-quality speakers, you can enjoy listening to music with rich sound. These can be managed through an application, and linked to LG’s other IoT devices, such as ThinQ plus, ThinQ light bulb, and ThinQ sensor.
(Photo: Various smart home-appliances from LG, linked to ThinQ hub)

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
